scope: Local metadata and source provenance only; no PDF rendering/text extraction, inference, network, GitHub or production changes. The user explicitly states all previous G1/G2 sources and variants were viewed.
decision: No existing local document is certified eligible for unseen holdout. Every listed group is excluded; uncertain provenance is ineligible.
group_leakage_rule: Group by original work before split. Same work, version, mirror, page/crop, native/scan, rotation, normalization, translation, synthetic paraphrase or derivative cannot cross development/holdout. All derivative ancestors must clear eligibility. Renaming, new bytes and a prior filename saying holdout do not create independence.

unexposed_local_document_assessment.reason: All discoverable PDFs belong to exposed research fixtures/derivatives or historical scratch experiments. Capture/download metadata and lack of a G1 case do not establish no prior viewing. The AIMA chapter-selection-pending label is not an unseen attestation. Uncertain historical matrix provenance is explicitly ineligible.
unexposed_local_document_assessment.future_candidates_require: Independent acquisition with provenance and exposure attestation, original-work identity and ancestor check against this entire exclusion list, then document/group split before content review or method tuning. Metadata-only new candidates are not eligible merely because absent from this inventory.

limits: Inventory covers PDFs physically present under this repository, including .scratch worktrees, and the selected local provenance/manifest artifacts; external downloads, remote stores, agent memories and model pretraining are not audited.
Exact hashes prove bytes, not document independence or absence of prior exposure.
G1 positive references are selected source scopes, not complete full-document labels or a successful candidate run.
No source/candidate pixels, transcripts or new output were inspected during this audit.

leakage_components.rule: Split connected components of original-work and derivative ancestry, not group_id records independently. The 32 work IDs are exclusion inventory, not 32 independent source/template families. Shared generation templates may create further dependence; independence remains uncertified.
leakage_components.internal_grouped_cv_policy: Controls, survey, NCCU and all their variants must occupy one partition. No internal grouped CV may separate those ancestors. All current local groups remain development/regression; no internal split is certified as unseen.
